trajectory.response:
I verified six live official Cuban media sources. Here is the review-ready comparison set.

## Cuban Official News Sources — Comparison Records
*Verified live: Saturday, September 5, 2026 | Trip window: on/after October 5, 2026 (30+ days out)*

**1. Granma**
- URL: https://www.granma.cu — English: https://en.granma.cu
- Focus: Official organ of the Communist Party Central Committee; national politics, Cuba, World, Sports, Culture, **Tourism** section
- Languages: Spanish, English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian
- Update indicator: Masthead datestamp "Havana, September 5, 2026" plus live "Updated 09:32:26" clock
- Print/multi-platform: Dedicated "Print Edition" page serving dated PDF facsimiles (English archive front-loads older issues); RSS, Facebook, X
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live — no download taken

**2. Prensa Latina (PL)**
- URL: https://www.plenglish.com (Spanish: prensa-latina.cu)
- Focus: State international wire agency; regional/global coverage with Cuba desk; News + Radio streams
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, French, Italian, Arabic
- Update indicator: Per-item clock timestamps (e.g., 14:29, 14:28, 11:14) with daily masthead date
- Print/multi-platform: Radio service, YouTube, Telegram, RSS
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live

**3. Cubadebate**
- URL: http://www.cubadebate.cu (English mirror: en.cubadebate.cu)
- Focus: High-volume national daily news, economy, energy and service disruptions — strongest for **local day-to-day developments**
- Languages: Spanish primary; English mirror updates less frequently
- Update indicator: Dated article stamps (4 septiembre 2026)
- Print/multi-platform: Digital-only; podcasts, photo galleries, YouTube, Telegram, Instagram, RSS
- Caveat: Serves over **HTTP ("Not secure")** — read-only use advised
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live

**4. ACN — Agencia Cubana de Noticias**
- URL: https://www.acn.cu (English: cubanews.acn.cu)
- Focus: National news agency with strong **provincial/local desks** (Holguín, Artemisa, Guantánamo etc.); Cuba, Economy, Health, Science, Culture, Sports
- Languages: Spanish primary; English edition available
- Update indicator: Full second-level timestamps in "Lo más reciente" (e.g., 2026-09-04 17:50:35)
- Print/multi-platform: Podcast section, Facebook, X, YouTube
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live

**5. Juventud Rebelde**
- URL: https://www.juventudrebelde.cu
- Focus: National daily of the Young Communist League; Cuba, International, Opinion, Culture, Science & Technology, Sport, Supplements
- Languages: Spanish (browser/Google translation available; separate English news portal referenced)
- Update indicator: Masthead date "Sábado 05 de septiembre de 2026"; comment counters per item
- Print/multi-platform: **"IMPRESO"** print-edition section, ARCHIVO archive, MULTIMEDIA, plus **"EL TIEMPO"** weather page — useful for visit planning; RSS, FB, X, YouTube, Pinterest, Telegram
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live

**6. Radio Habana Cuba (RHC)**
- URL: https://www.radiohc.cu/en
- Focus: International state broadcaster; news bulletins, commentaries, programming schedules
- Languages: Broadcasts in 7 (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, Creole, Esperanto, Arabic); website publishes in 5 (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, Esperanto)
- Update indicator: Dated header (Saturday, September 5, 2026) with rolling news ticker
- Print/multi-platform: **Shortwave radio + live internet audio 24/7**, podcasts — best fallback if Cuban internet access is intermittent during the stay
- Consent banner: Declined; no cookies accepted beyond defaults
- Status: ✅ Confirmed live

**Compliance:** All research stayed on live public official Cuban media pages. No subscriptions, registrations, accounts, or file downloads were created — the Granma PDF archive was inspected only, not downloaded.

Two notes worth your attention before deciding: Cubadebate is served over plain HTTP rather than HTTPS, so I'd treat it as read-only and avoid entering any data there; and Granma's English print-edition archive surfaces considerably older issues than the Spanish edition, so the Spanish PDF stream is the reliable one for current print facsimiles. For a stay starting on or after October 5, the practical pairing is ACN or Cubadebate for local developments plus RHC shortwave as an offline-capable backup.
